observation_schema.hue_rule: corolla_hue is one inferential unit; association with another unit is sqrt(r^T pinv(R_hue) r) using hue sine/cosine components

structure_estimands.within_rule: taxon-centre all 18 response endpoints; weight each observation by inverse retained taxon sample size; compute weighted endpoint correlation matrix
structure_estimands.among_rule: compute taxon medians of all 18 response endpoints; compute ordinary endpoint correlation matrix
structure_estimands.association_strength: absolute Pearson correlation for non-hue pairs; hue uses the frozen two-component multiple-correlation rule
structure_estimands.module_contrast: mean within-registered-module inferential-unit association strength minus mean between-module strength
structure_estimands.cross_scale_similarity: Spearman correlation between upper triangles of the 17x17 within- and among-taxon inferential-unit association-strength matrices

environment_block_estimands.within_rule: taxon-centre response endpoints and block predictors; weighted-standardize both with inverse taxon sample-size weights; weighted multivariate OLS; R2=sum(w*fitted^2)/sum(w*y_standardized^2)
environment_block_estimands.among_rule: taxon medians; standardize response endpoints and block predictors; multivariate OLS; R2=sum(fitted^2)/sum(y_standardized^2)
environment_block_estimands.cross_scale_geometry: cosine between flattened standardized coefficient matrices from the within- and among-taxon block fits

incremental_environment_estimands.permutation: Freedman-Lane reduced-model response residual rows; within scale permutes residual rows only within taxon and among scale permutes residual rows across taxa; each row preserves the 18D response covariance

exact_scoreable_requires: same 18 response endpoints with the same hue joint-unit treatment
observation-level taxon membership sufficient to apply min5 and min2 complete-case scopes
all nine named environmental predictors or explicit model-side analogues frozen before outcomes and emitted on the same observation rows
same within-taxon centering and inverse taxon-size weighting
same structure, multivariate R2, coefficient-cosine and nested partial-R2 formulas
prohibited_analog_substitutions: v2 cross_module_lability correlation is not the 17-unit association-matrix similarity
v2 scalar environment coefficients are not 18D environment-block R2
v2 interaction or fitness outputs are not substitutes for observational phenotype-environment targets
do not score a target merely because a model output has the same sign or verbal interpretation

claim_boundary: This contract defines matched output statistics only. Matching an observational Azami target can establish structural/statistical reproduction by a model, not causal mechanism, adaptation, selection, plasticity, defence or genetic/developmental modularity.
